ModMetaData.name: Control Groups
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
StarCraft-style control groups for pawns.
- Ctrl+number (Cmd+number on Mac): assign the selected pawns to group 0-9 - Shift+number: add the selected pawns to the group - Alt+number (Option+number on Mac): select the group; press twice quickly to jump the camera to it - Plain number keys stay as game speed keys - Groups are saved with the game and can include pawns on other maps or in caravans
